(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][PiercingLine]";

const ANIM_KEY = "piercingLine.orange45";

// --- Tunables ---

const MOVE_OUT_MS = 220;

const MOVE_BACK_MS = 220;

const DX_RIGHT = 80; // "slide caster right a bit"

const VFX_SCALE = 1.0;

const VFX_ROT_DEG = -45; // counter-clockwise

const HOLD_FALLBACK_MS = 900; // if webm duration can't be read in time

const VFX_WEBM = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Line/Generic/Piercing_Generic01_01_Regular_Orange_1000x400.webm";

const SFX_OGG = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind7.ogg";

try {

if (!canvas?.ready) return ui.notifications.warn("Canvas not ready.");

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active (needed for SFX).");

return;

}

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation core not found: game.ONI.pseudo.play");

return;

}

// Ensure ONI.emit exists (per codex template style)

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// Resolve caster token (prefer __PAYLOAD, else controlled)

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const sourceToken =

payload?.casterToken

?? payload?._token

?? canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0]

?? game.user.character?.getActiveTokens?.()[0];

if (!sourceToken) return ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found.");

const targets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const targetIds = targets.map(t => t.id);

// --- Emit animationStart (after resolving caster/targets) ---

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: ANIM_KEY,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targetIds,

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

// --- SFX (Sequencer only) ---

// Fire the SFX right when the VFX begins (after move-out finishes)

const sfxSeq = new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(SFX_OGG)

.delay(MOVE_OUT_MS)

.volume(0.9);

sfxSeq.play(); // non-blocking; the cinematic wait is the pseudo session

// --- PSEUDO: move out -> play webm VFX -> move back (ONE continuous session) ---

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

// Helpers

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3) / 2;

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

// ✅ NEW: Flip horizontally (mirror)

// Use abs to avoid double-flipping if anything else sets negative scale.

sprite.scale.x = -Math.abs(sprite.scale.x);

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zToken ?? 5000);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

// WEBM sprite (video texture) anchored at caster

async function createWebmVfxAt(x, y, file, scale, rotDeg) {

// Create HTMLVideoElement

const video = document.createElement("video");

video.src = file;

video.crossOrigin = "anonymous";

video.preload = "auto";

video.loop = false;

video.muted = true; // keep muted; SFX is handled separately

video.playsInline = true;

// Wait for metadata so duration is available (best effort)

const durationMs = await new Promise(resolve => {

const done = () => {

const d = Number.isFinite(video.duration) && video.duration > 0

? Math.round(video.duration * 1000)

: Number(params.holdFallbackMs ?? 900);

resolve(d);

};

video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", done, { once: true });

video.addEventListener("error", () => resolve(Number(params.holdFallbackMs ?? 900)), { once: true });

// safety: if metadata never arrives quickly, fall back

setTimeout(() => resolve(Number(params.holdFallbackMs ?? 900)), 250);

});

// Start playback (must happen after user gesture in some browsers; we assume Foundry already had one)

try { await video.play(); } catch (_) { /* ignore; texture may still render first frame */ }

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(video);

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

spr.anchor.set(0.5);

spr.x = x;

spr.y = y;

spr.scale.set(Number(scale ?? 1));

spr.rotation = (Number(rotDeg ?? 0) * Math.PI) / 180;

spr.zIndex = Number(params.zVfx ?? 6000);

canvas.stage.addChild(spr);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return { spr, video, durationMs };

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let clone, vfx;

try {

// Cache home position (CENTER-based, exact return)

const home = { x: casterToken.center.x, y: casterToken.center.y };

// Clone + hide real token locally

clone = await createClone(casterToken);

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

// 1) Slide caster RIGHT a bit

const out = { x: home.x + Number(params.dxRight ?? 0), y: home.y };

await animateXY(clone, home, out, Number(params.moveOutMs ?? 220));

// 2) Play WEBM VFX at caster (while in slid position)

vfx = await createWebmVfxAt(

clone.x,

clone.y,

String(params.vfxWebm),

Number(params.vfxScale ?? 2),

Number(params.vfxRotDeg ?? -45)

);

// Hold for the VFX duration (best effort)

await wait(Number(vfx.durationMs ?? params.holdFallbackMs ?? 900));

// Cleanup VFX

try {

if (vfx?.spr) { canvas.stage.removeChild(vfx.spr); vfx.spr.destroy(); }

if (vfx?.video) { vfx.video.pause(); vfx.video.src = ""; vfx.video.load(); }

} catch (_) {}

// 3) Slide back to original position

await animateXY(clone, out, home, Number(params.moveBackMs ?? 220));

} finally {

if (vfx?.spr) {

try { canvas.stage.removeChild(vfx.spr); vfx.spr.destroy(); } catch (_) {}

}

if (vfx?.video) {

try { vfx.video.pause(); vfx.video.src = ""; vfx.video.load(); } catch (_) {}

}

if (clone) {

try { canvas.stage.removeChild(clone); clone.destroy(); } catch (_) {}

}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

// The awaited cinematic is the pseudo session

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: targets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: {

dxRight: DX_RIGHT,

moveOutMs: MOVE_OUT_MS,

moveBackMs: MOVE_BACK_MS,

vfxWebm: VFX_WEBM,

vfxScale: VFX_SCALE,

vfxRotDeg: VFX_ROT_DEG,

holdFallbackMs: HOLD_FALLBACK_MS,

zToken: 5000,

zVfx: 6000

},

meta: { source: "Piercing Line Orange -45" }

});

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed:", err);

} finally {

// --- Emit animationEnd (ALWAYS, even on error) ---

try {

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const sourceToken =

payload?.casterToken

?? payload?._token

?? canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0];

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: ANIM_KEY,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null,

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

} catch (_) {}

}

})();

const TUNE = {

rotationOffsetDeg: 0,

// Visual tuning

scale: 20, // ✅ updated

opacity: 1.0,

// Audio tuning

const VFX_PROJECTILE =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/RangedSpell/03/RangedProjectile03_01_Regular_BlueGreen_30ft_1600x400.webm";

const SFX_HIT =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_Piercing.wav";

// -------------------------

// Helpers

// -------------------------

function ensureONIEmit() {

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

}

function resolveSourceToken() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const fromPayload = p?.sourceToken ?? p?._token ?? null;

if (fromPayload?.document) return fromPayload;

const controlled = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

return controlled;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const fromPayload = p?.targets ?? p?.targetTokens ?? null;

if (Array.isArray(fromPayload) && fromPayload.length) return fromPayload;

return Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

}

function computeAngleDeg(fromToken, toToken) {

const dx = (toToken.center?.x ?? toToken.x) - (fromToken.center?.x ?? fromToken.x);

const dy = (toToken.center?.y ?? toToken.y) - (fromToken.center?.y ?? fromToken.y);

const rad = Math.atan2(dy, dx);

return (rad * 180) / Math.PI;

}

async function playLocalSequencer(sourceToken, targetToken) {

const angle = computeAngleDeg(sourceToken, targetToken) + Number(TUNE.rotationOffsetDeg ?? 0);

const seq = new Sequence()

.effect()

.file(VFX_PROJECTILE)

.atLocation(sourceToken)

.stretchTo(targetToken)

.rotate(angle)

.scale(TUNE.scale)

.opacity(TUNE.opacity)

.waitUntilFinished(-250);

await seq.play();

}

// ✅ Damage SFX: play ONE TIME, broadcast to all clients (Foundry native)

async function playDamageSfxLocal() {

await AudioHelper.play(

{ src: SFX_HIT, volume: TUNE.sfxVolume, autoplay: true, loop: false },

true

);

}

function broadcastToOtherClients(sourceToken, targetToken) {

const pseudo = game.ONI?.pseudo;

if (!pseudo?.play) {

console.warn(TAG, "game.ONI.pseudo.play not found — playing locally only.");

return;

}

const scriptSource = `

const VFX_PROJECTILE = ${JSON.stringify(VFX_PROJECTILE)};

const TUNE = ${JSON.stringify(TUNE)};

function angleDeg(fromToken, toToken) {

const fx = fromToken.center?.x ?? fromToken.x;

const fy = fromToken.center?.y ?? fromToken.y;

const tx = toToken.center?.x ?? toToken.x;

const ty = toToken.center?.y ?? toToken.y;

const rad = Math.atan2(ty - fy, tx - fx);

return (rad * 180) / Math.PI;

}

const { casterToken, targetTokens } = ctx;

const targetToken = targetTokens?.[0];

if (!casterToken || !targetToken) return;

const angle = angleDeg(casterToken, targetToken) + Number(TUNE.rotationOffsetDeg ?? 0);

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) return;

const seq = new Sequence()

.effect()

.file(VFX_PROJECTILE)

.atLocation(casterToken)

.stretchTo(targetToken)

.rotate(angle)

.scale(TUNE.scale)

.opacity(TUNE.opacity);

await seq.play();

`;

pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: { ...TUNE },

meta: { source: "SpearThrowProjectile" },

});

}

// -------------------------

// Main

// -------------------------

ensureONIEmit();

let sourceToken, targets;

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

sourceToken = resolveSourceToken();

targets = resolveTargets();

if (!sourceToken) return ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found (select a token).");

if (!targets?.length) return ui.notifications.warn("No target found (target 1 token).");

const targetToken = targets[0];

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: ANIM_KEY,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

}, { local: true, world: false });

// Projectile visuals (others + local)

broadcastToOtherClients(sourceToken, targetToken);

await playLocalSequencer(sourceToken, targetToken);

// ✅ Only here = “damage dealt” moment

await playDamageSfxLocal();

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed:", err);

} finally {

try {

const targetIds = (targets ?? []).map(t => t?.id).filter(Boolean);

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: ANIM_KEY,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: targetIds,

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

}, { local: true, world: false });

} catch (_) {}

}

})();

// Piercing Talon — PIERCE (Resolution)

// Pierce: if the action MISSES, still deal 50% damage (round up) as Physical damage.

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-RES][PIERCE]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? p?.__confirmArgs ?? {};

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

// --- Accuracy (pipeline-first, then args fallback) ---

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

// --- DEF snapshot (physical) ---

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.def ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

// --- Hit/Miss rule (Accuracy >= Defense) ---

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const usedDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= usedDef;

};

// --- Planned damage (same style as before) ---

const ap = p?.advPayload ?? p?.actionContext?.advPayload ?? {};

const base = parseInt(String(ap?.baseValue ?? "0").replace("+", ""), 10) || 0;

const bonus = Number(ap?.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

const reduction = Number(ap?.reduction ?? 0) || 0;

const multPct = Number(ap?.multiplier ?? 100) || 100;

const planned = Math.max(0, Math.floor((base + bonus - reduction) * (multPct / 100)));

const pierceDamage = Math.ceil(planned * 0.5);

if (pierceDamage <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No pierce damage to apply", { planned, pierceDamage });

return;

}

const attackerUuid = String(p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? ap?.attackerUuid ?? "");

const ADV = game.macros.getName("AdvanceDamage");

if (!ADV) return console.warn(TAG, `Macro "AdvanceDamage" not found.`);

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

for (const tuuid of targetUuids) {

const td = await fromUuid(tuuid).catch(() => null);

const targetActor = td?.actor ?? td;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const hit = isHit(tuuid, targetActor);

// HIT: do nothing

if (hit) {

console.log(TAG, "HIT — Pierce does nothing", {

target: targetActor?.name,

accTotal,

def: getDef(tuuid, targetActor)

});

continue;

}

// MISS: apply 50% via AdvanceDamage

const tokenId =

(td?.documentName === "Token" || td?.documentName === "TokenDocument") ? (td?.id ?? td?._id ?? null)

: canvas?.tokens?.placeables?.find(t => t?.actor?.id === targetActor.id)?.id ?? null;

if (!tokenId) {

console.warn(TAG, "MISS but cannot resolve tokenId; skipping", { target: targetActor?.name, tuuid });

continue;

}

console.log(TAG, "MISS — Applying Pierce (50%)", {

target: targetActor?.name,

accTotal,

def: getDef(tuuid, targetActor),

planned,

pierceDamage

});

globalThis.__AUTO = true;

globalThis.__PAYLOAD = {

targetIds: [tokenId],

baseValue: String(pierceDamage),

bonus: 0,

reduction: 0,

multiplier: 100,

valueType: "hp",

elementType: "physical",

weaponType: "none_ef",

attackerUuid

};

await ADV.execute();

delete globalThis.__AUTO;

delete globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

}

})();

// ============================================================================

// Custom Logic - Resolution : Dragonfire Dive (Proximity Splash AOE)

// "Deals 50% of the damage to adjacent creature(s)"

// - Splash area is computed from your JRPG layout points (no fixed slot matching)

// - Deals splash to ALL tokens inside radius (excluding the main target)

// - Applies damage by injecting payload into AdvanceDamage (AUTO mode)

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-RES][DragonfireDive][SplashAOE]";

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// Helpers

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);

const getCenter = (tok) => {

if (tok?.center) return { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y };

const d = tok?.document ?? tok;

const w = (d?.width ?? 1) * (canvas?.grid?.size ?? 100);

const h = (d?.height ?? 1) * (canvas?.grid?.size ?? 100);

return { x: (d?.x ?? 0) + w / 2, y: (d?.y ?? 0) + h / 2 };

};

const toNum = (v, d = 0) => {

const n = Number(v);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : d;

};

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// 1) Resolve MAIN target token (first target)

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const mainTargetUuid = targetUuids[0];

if (!mainTargetUuid) return console.warn(TAG, "No main target in payload.targets");

const mainTargetDoc = await fromUuid(mainTargetUuid);

const mainTargetToken = mainTargetDoc?.object ?? mainTargetDoc; // TokenDocument -> Token

if (!mainTargetToken) return console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve main target token", mainTargetUuid);

const origin = getCenter(mainTargetToken);

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// 2) Read "damage dealt" from pipeline (best-effort)

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? {};

let dealt =

toNum(p?.meta?.finalDamageDealt ?? p?.meta?.damageDealt ?? p?.damageDealt ??

args?.finalDamageDealt ?? args?.damageDealt ?? args?.finalDamage ?? 0, 0);

// Fallback: if your pipeline carries an "advPayload"-like object

if (dealt <= 0) {

const ap = args?.advPayload ?? p?.advPayload ?? {};

const base = parseInt(String(ap?.baseValue ?? "0").replace("+", ""), 10) || 0;

const bonus = toNum(ap?.bonus, 0);

const reduction = toNum(ap?.reduction, 0);

const multPct = toNum(ap?.multiplier, 100);

dealt = Math.max(0, Math.floor((base + bonus - reduction) * (multPct / 100)));

}

if (dealt <= 0) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not determine dealt damage (all sources were 0). Aborting splash.", {

meta: p?.meta,

argsKeys: Object.keys(args ?? {}),

advPayload: args?.advPayload ?? p?.advPayload

});

return;

}

const splash = Math.ceil(dealt * 0.5);

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// 3) Compute splash radius from YOUR layout points

// Goal: include "adjacent" spacing, exclude "two slots away"

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const LAYOUT = [

{ x: 790, y: 203 },

{ x: 887, y: 261 },

{ x: 985, y: 320 },

{ x: 1082, y: 378 },

];

// Adjacent distances (1-2, 2-3, 3-4)

const adj = [

dist(LAYOUT[0], LAYOUT[1]),

dist(LAYOUT[1], LAYOUT[2]),

dist(LAYOUT[2], LAYOUT[3]),

];

const maxAdj = Math.max(...adj);

// Two-steps-away distances (1-3, 2-4) -> this is what we must NOT reach

const skip = [

dist(LAYOUT[0], LAYOUT[2]),

dist(LAYOUT[1], LAYOUT[3]),

];

const minSkip = Math.min(...skip);

// Radius = midpoint between "adjacent max" and "two-away min"

// + tiny buffer so adjacent always counts, but still safely under 2-away

const radius = Math.floor(((maxAdj + minSkip) / 2) * 0.98);

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// 4) Find ALL tokens within radius of main target (exclude main target)

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const allTokens = canvas?.tokens?.placeables ?? [];

const splashTargets = allTokens.filter(t => {

if (!t?.actor) return false; // must be a creature token

if (t.document?.uuid === mainTargetToken.document?.uuid) return false; // exclude main target

const c = getCenter(t);

return dist(origin, c) <= radius;

});

if (splashTargets.length === 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No tokens inside splash radius.", {

mainTarget: mainTargetToken?.name,

radius,

dealt,

splash

});

return;

}

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// 5) Inject payload into AdvanceDamage to apply splash properly

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const ADV = game.macros.getName("AdvanceDamage");

if (!ADV) {

ui.notifications.error("AdvanceDamage macro not found (name must be exactly: AdvanceDamage).");

return;

}

// Best-effort passthrough of context (so logs/affinity behave like the main hit)

const attackerUuid =

(p?.attackerUuid ?? p?.actionContext?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? "").toString();

const elementType =

(p?.elementType ?? p?.actionContext?.elementType ?? p?.advPayload?.elementType ?? p?.meta?.elementType ?? "elementless").toString();

const weaponType =

(p?.weaponType ?? p?.actionContext?.weaponType ?? p?.advPayload?.weaponType ?? p?.meta?.weaponType ?? "none_ef").toString();

// IMPORTANT: AdvanceDamage supports headless targeting via PAYLOAD.targetIds when AUTO is true.

// It accepts token IDs (t.id or t.document.id). We'll use t.id.

const targetIds = splashTargets.map(t => t.id);

const advPayload = {

// headless mode

targetIds,

// damage inputs

baseValue: String(splash), // "N" = damage, "+N" = heal

reduction: 0,

bonus: 0,

multiplier: 100,

// damage context

valueType: "hp",

targetAffinity: "neutral",

ignoreDamageReduction: false,

ignoreShield: false,

// pass through so your logs/cards show correct source & element

attackerUuid,

elementType,

weaponType,

// carry full context if you want cards to show it

actionContext: p?.actionContext ?? null,

attackerName: p?.attackerName ?? p?.attacker ?? "None",

attackRange: p?.attackRange ?? "None",

sourceType: p?.sourceType ?? "None",

};

// ✅ NEW: wait 1500ms before dealing splash damage

await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));

// Your system convention: inject as globals, then execute macro.

globalThis.__AUTO = true;

globalThis.__PAYLOAD = advPayload;

try {

await ADV.execute();

} finally {

// clean up so we don't leak headless state to other macros

try { delete globalThis.__AUTO; } catch (e) {}

try { delete globalThis.__PAYLOAD; } catch (e) {}

}

console.log(TAG, "Splash applied via AdvanceDamage", {

mainTarget: mainTargetToken?.name,

dealt,

splash,

radius,

splashTargets: splashTargets.map(t => t.name)

});

})();

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][MeleeGeneric]";

const ANIM_TYPE = "melee.generic.jumpPierce";

try {

// --- Checks (Sequencer only needed for SFX now) ---

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API is not available (game.ONI.pseudo.play).");

return;

}

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active (needed for SFX).");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// --- Assets ---

const VFX_FILE =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Line/Generic/Piercing_Generic01_01_Regular_Orange_1000x400.webm";

const SFX_FILE =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_Piercing.wav";

// --- Tuning knobs ---

const MOVE_MS = 260; // jump out speed

const BACK_MS = 260; // jump back speed

const VFX_MS = 900; // how long the pseudo VFX stays (video lifetime)

const VFX_SCALE = 0.5; // absolute scale knob (pseudo sprite scale)

const FRONT_SQUARES = 0.65; // distance in front of target (grid squares)

const JUMP_HEIGHT_MULT = 0.35; // jump arc height (grid squares)

const SFX_VOL = 0.95;

// --- Payload / resolve tokens (Muleta-style, compatible with your pipeline) ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) return ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found (payload missing and nothing selected).");

if (!targets.length) return ui.notifications.warn("No target found (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

const targetToken = targets[0];

// --- Disposition rule: FRONT OF TARGET based on TARGET disposition (your fixed behavior) ---

const targetDisposition =

targetToken?.document?.disposition ??

targetToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const targetHostile = targetDisposition === -1;

const frontIsRightOfTarget = targetHostile; // hostile faces right => front right; ally faces left => front left

// --- Compute front position + movement delta ---

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * FRONT_SQUARES;

const home = { x: sourceToken.center.x, y: sourceToken.center.y };

const front = {

x: targetToken.center.x + (frontIsRightOfTarget ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx),

y: targetToken.center.y,

};

const dx = front.x - home.x;

const dy = front.y - home.y;

const jumpHPx = canvas.grid.size * JUMP_HEIGHT_MULT;

// --- Emit animation start (hard rule) ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: ANIM_TYPE,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

meta: { targetDisposition, frontIsRightOfTarget },

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// --- PSEUDO SCRIPT: move -> spawn VFX sprite at "front" -> cleanup -> return ---

const pseudoScriptSource = `

const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

const targetToken = targetTokens?.[0];

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("MeleeGeneric pseudo: missing casterToken");

if (!targetToken) throw new Error("MeleeGeneric pseudo: missing targetToken");

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function animateJump(sprite, from, to, durMs, jumpH) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

const yLine = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

const arc = Math.sin(Math.PI * e) * jumpH;

sprite.x = x;

sprite.y = yLine - arc;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

// Preserve transform (no auto flip / no facing changes)

if (baseObj) {

sprite.rotation = baseObj.rotation ?? 0;

const signX = Math.sign(baseObj.scale?.x ?? 1) || 1;

const signY = Math.sign(baseObj.scale?.y ?? 1) || 1;

sprite.scale.x = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x) * signX;

sprite.scale.y = Math.abs(sprite.scale.y) * signY;

}

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

function angleTo(from, to) {

return Math.atan2(to.y - from.y, to.x - from.x);

}

async function spawnVfxAt(pos, targetToken, file, scale, lifetimeMs) {

const tex = await loadTexture(file);

const fx = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

fx.anchor.set(0.5);

fx.x = pos.x;

fx.y = pos.y;

fx.zIndex = 5200;

fx.scale.set(Number(scale ?? 1.0));

// Rotate to face the target (looks like a thrust)

fx.rotation = angleTo({ x: fx.x, y: fx.y }, targetToken.center);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(fx);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

// Try to start video playback if it's a video texture

// (Safe: if it isn't video, nothing breaks)

try {

const bt = tex?.baseTexture;

const res = bt?.resource;

const src = res?.source;

if (src?.currentTime !== undefined) {

src.loop = false;

src.currentTime = 0;

await src.play?.();

}

} catch (_) {}

await sleep(Number(lifetimeMs ?? 800));

// Stop video if possible, then cleanup

try {

const bt = tex?.baseTexture;

const res = bt?.resource;

const src = res?.source;

src?.pause?.();

} catch (_) {}

canvas.stage.removeChild(fx);

fx.destroy(); // do NOT destroy shared textures

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

// Hide real token locally

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const start = { x: sprite.x, y: sprite.y };

const out = { x: start.x + Number(params.dx ?? 0), y: start.y + Number(params.dy ?? 0) };

const outMs = Number(params.outMs ?? 260);

const backMs = Number(params.backMs ?? 260);

const jumpH = Number(params.jumpH ?? 30);

// Jump to front

await animateJump(sprite, start, out, outMs, jumpH);

// HIT MOMENT: spawn pseudo VFX at EXACT "front" position (same as jump-to)

await spawnVfxAt(

{ x: out.x, y: out.y },

targetToken,

params.vfxFile,

params.vfxScale,

params.vfxMs

);

// Jump back

await animateJump(sprite, out, start, backMs, jumpH);

} finally {

if (sprite) { canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite); sprite.destroy(); }

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

// Run pseudo (movement + VFX)

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.meleeGeneric.jumpPierce.pseudoVfx",

scriptSource: pseudoScriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: {

dx,

dy,

outMs: MOVE_MS,

backMs: BACK_MS,

jumpH: jumpHPx,

vfxFile: VFX_FILE,

vfxScale: VFX_SCALE,

vfxMs: VFX_MS,

},

meta: { source: "Melee Generic (Pseudo VFX)" },

});

// SFX timing: play when the caster reaches front (MOVE_MS + tiny buffer)

const delayToHit = MOVE_MS + 30;

await new Sequence()

.wait(delayToHit)

.sound()

.file(SFX_FILE)

.volume(SFX_VOL)

.play();

// Wait for full cinematic window (move out + vfx lifetime + move back)

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, MOVE_MS + VFX_MS + BACK_MS + 120));

// --- Emit animation end (hard rule; after cleanup/wait) ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: ANIM_TYPE,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "melee.generic.jumpPierce", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ??

}

// IMPORTANT: match pipeline "spellish => use magic defense"

(typeof args.isSpellish === "boolean") ? args.isSpellish :

(typeof p?.meta?.isSpellish === "boolean") ? p.meta.isSpellish :

false;

return Number(row?.def ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

if (autoHit) return true; // auto-hit flags

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= usedDef; // same rule as applyDamage-button

};

// Custom Logic - Resolution : Rebellion Wing Cleanup

//

// - Deletes the persistent caster sprite (stored via token flag)

// - Restores caster token alpha back to 1.0

// - GM-side authoritative (Resolution phase)

//

// Update (multi-client sync):

// - Uses game.ONI.pseudo.play() to broadcast client-side cleanup:

// * destroy persistent sprite

// * stop idle floater ticker

// * local alpha snap (best effort)

// - GM still performs authoritative TokenDocument updates + flag unset.

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-RES][RebellionWing][Cleanup]";

try {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

if (!game?.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

console.warn(TAG, "ONI Pseudo Animation API not found: game.ONI.pseudo.play");

// We can still do GM-side alpha/flag cleanup, but sprite removal won't broadcast.

}

// --- Resolve attacker (caster) document from payload ---

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attacker_uuid ??

p?.casterUuid ??

p?.caster_uuid ??

null;

if (!attackerUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "No attackerUuid in payload. Cannot cleanup.");

return;

}

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

// attackerDoc could be TokenDocument or Actor; prefer TokenDocument if possible

const casterTokenDoc =

attackerDoc?.documentName === "Token" ? attackerDoc :

attackerDoc?.documentName === "TokenDocument" ? attackerDoc :

attackerDoc?.document?.documentName === "TokenDocument" ? attackerDoc.document :

null;

// Fallback: if attackerUuid is Actor, try to use the first active token in current scene

let tokenDoc = casterTokenDoc;

if (!tokenDoc && attackerDoc?.documentName === "Actor") {

const active = attackerDoc?.getActiveTokens?.(true, true) ?? [];

tokenDoc = active?.[0]?.document ?? null;

}

if (!tokenDoc) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve caster TokenDocument from attackerUuid:", attackerUuid);

return;

}

// --- Read the flag written by the animation macro ---

const flag = tokenDoc.getFlag("fabula-ultima-companion", "rebellionWing") ?? null;

const spriteKey = flag?.spriteKey ?? null;

console.log(TAG, "BEGIN", {

attackerUuid,

token: { id: tokenDoc.id, name: tokenDoc.name, uuid: tokenDoc.uuid },

spriteKey,

hasSpriteMap: !!globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES,

});

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

// 1) Broadcast client-side cleanup via Pseudo API (multi-client)

// This removes the persistent sprite + floater ticker on EACH client.

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

const clientCleanupScript = `

const TAG = "[CL-RES][RebellionWing][Cleanup][Client]";

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

const spriteKey = params.spriteKey != null ? String(params.spriteKey) : null;

const forceAlpha = Number(params.forceAlpha ?? 1);

try {

// A) Stop idle floater ticker if present

if (spriteKey && globalThis.__ONI_RW_FLOATERS instanceof Map) {

const floater = globalThis.__ONI_RW_FLOATERS.get(String(spriteKey));

if (floater?.ticker && floater?.update) {

try {

floater.ticker.remove(floater.update);

console.log(TAG, "Floater ticker removed:", spriteKey);

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "Failed to remove floater ticker:", spriteKey, e);

}

}

globalThis.__ONI_RW_FLOATERS.delete(String(spriteKey));

}

// B) Destroy sprite object on this client

if (spriteKey && globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES instanceof Map) {

const sprite = globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES.get(String(spriteKey));

if (sprite) {

try {

// Use simple destroy (safe) — avoid destroying shared textures

sprite.destroy();

console.log(TAG, "Sprite destroyed:", spriteKey);

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "Failed to destroy sprite:", spriteKey, e);

}

globalThis.__ONI_RW_SPRITES.delete(String(spriteKey));

} else {

console.warn(TAG, "No sprite found in __ONI_RW_SPRITES for key:", spriteKey);

}

} else {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing spriteKey or __ONI_RW_SPRITES map; sprite not removed.");

}

// C) Best-effort local alpha snap (no visibility toggles)

// The authoritative alpha comes from TokenDocument update (GM), but this makes it feel instant.

if (casterToken) {

try {

if (casterToken?.mesh) casterToken.mesh.alpha = forceAlpha;

if (casterToken?.icon) casterToken.icon.alpha = forceAlpha;

casterToken.alpha = forceAlpha;

} catch (_) {}

try { casterToken.renderFlags?.set?.({ refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {}

try { casterToken.refresh?.(); } catch (_) {}

}

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "Client cleanup crashed:", err);

}

`;

// Fire-and-forget broadcast; do not block the resolution pipeline.

if (game?.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

try {

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "cl.res.rebellionWingCleanup",

scriptSource: clientCleanupScript,

casterTokenUuid: tokenDoc.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: {

spriteKey: spriteKey ?? null,

forceAlpha: 1,

},

meta: { source: "CL-RES Rebellion Wing Cleanup" },

});

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "pseudo.play threw (continuing):", e);

}

}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

// 2) GM authoritative: restore TokenDocument alpha to 1.0

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

try {

await tokenDoc.update({ alpha: 1.0 }, { animate: false }).catch(() => tokenDoc.update({ alpha: 1.0 }));

console.log(TAG, "Token alpha restored to 1.0");

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "Failed to restore token alpha:", e);

}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

// 3) Optional: clear the flag so it doesn't get reused accidentally

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------

try {

await tokenDoc.unsetFlag("fabula-ultima-companion", "rebellionWing");

console.log(TAG, "Token flag cleared: fabula-ultima-companion.rebellionWing");

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "Failed to clear flag (non-fatal):", e);

}

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "CRASHED:", err);

}

})();

payload

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

vid.loop = false;

vid.muted = true; // SFX is separate

// If caster has Active Effect "Flying", add +10 bonus damage.

// Priority: match by Effect ID (from provided UUID) -> fallback match by name "Flying"

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][FLYING->BONUS10]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

// 1) Resolve attacker/caster actor

const attackerUuid = p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "";

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

return console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor from UUID:", attackerUuid);

}

const FLYING_EFFECT_UUID =

"Actor.LnlydRl7Ed7agd1g.Item.yfZbxLNZwsy6lcW0.ActiveEffect.2bUi37PPeGTeuymZ";

// Extract the actual ActiveEffect ID (last segment)

const flyingEffectId = String(FLYING_EFFECT_UUID).split(".").pop();

// 3) Check for Flying effect:

// A) by ID

// B) fallback by name "Flying" (case-insensitive)

const effects = attackerActor.effects; // ActiveEffect collection

const hasById = flyingEffectId ? !!effects?.get(flyingEffectId) : false;

const hasByName = !hasById

? Array.from(effects ?? []).some((ef) => String(ef?.name ?? "").toLowerCase() === "flying")

attacker: attackerActor.name,

checkedEffectId: flyingEffectId,

});

}
